meta.prompt: Show the plan for migrating my blog as six steps: Back up your content, Set up the new host, Import posts, Move media, Redirect old URLs, Final checks, each with a short description. A Start button runs them one after another, 2 seconds each: a spinner on the running step, ticks on the finished ones, a progress bar that reads "N of 6 steps" with the seconds elapsed, and a Pause button. When all six are done, a summary says "Migration complete" and the total time in seconds.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Blog migration" "Six steps, two seconds each" icon:"swap_horiz" status:"Ready"
  state step=0
  state running=false
  state done=0
  state elapsed=0
  every 1000 when running -> elapsed += 1
  every 2000 when running -> done += 1; step = min(6, step + 1)
  if done >= 6
    running = false
  each s in ["Back up your content","Set up the new host","Import posts","Move media","Redirect old URLs","Final checks"]
    PlanStep "{s}" "Step detail" index:0 current:=done running:=running
  ProgressLine "{done} of 6 steps" "{elapsed} s elapsed" value:=done/6
  Row gap:10
    ActionButton "Start" primary -> running = true
    ActionButton "Pause" quiet -> running = false
  if done >= 6
    Receipt "Migration complete" "Total time {elapsed} s" tone:good
